references.text: Both texts describe the counting of seven weeks from the beginning of the grain harvest to the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot/Pentecost)
The continuation of the same text specifies that the count should be fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath
The context for the wave offering (omer) which marks the start of the counting mentioned in verse 15
Refers to the Feast of Weeks celebrated at the conclusion of the seven weeks being counted
Pentecost in the New Testament is the fulfillment of the fifty days counted from Passover, based on the count in Leviticus 23:15
Paul's desire to be in Jerusalem by Pentecost shows the continued significance of this feast marked after counting seven weeks
